quantity_convention: Quantitative estimates carry low/base/high. A sourced point has identical endpoints; a sourced interval with no central statistic has base null. Identifiers, editions, dates, section numbers and Git hashes are metadata, not measured numeric estimates. HUMAN_INPUT is null/null/null, never zero. Ordinal package scores are assumptions with scenario envelopes, not statistical confidence intervals.
